actors_identity_check.name: actors_identity_check
actors_identity_check.value: ("actors"."type" = 'human' AND "actors"."user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("actors"."type" = 'agent' AND "actors"."user_id" IS NULL)

file_upload_owner.name: file_upload_owner
file_upload_owner.value: ("file_uploads"."purpose" = 'avatar' AND "file_uploads"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "file_uploads"."organization_id" IS NULL AND "file_uploads"."uploaded_by" = "file_uploads"."owner_user_id") OR ("file_uploads"."purpose" IN ('organization-logo', 'file') AND "file_uploads"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "file_uploads"."owner_user_id" IS NULL)

stored_file_owner.name: stored_file_owner
stored_file_owner.value: ("stored_files"."purpose" = 'avatar' AND "stored_files"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stored_files"."organization_id" IS NULL AND "stored_files"."uploaded_by" = "stored_files"."owner_user_id") OR ("stored_files"."purpose" IN ('organization-logo', 'file') AND "stored_files"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stored_files"."owner_user_id" IS NULL)

messaging_task_discussion_check.name: messaging_task_discussion_check
messaging_task_discussion_check.value: "messaging_conversations"."task_entity_id" IS NULL OR ("messaging_conversations"."kind" = 'group' AND "messaging_conversations"."private" AND "messaging_conversations"."dm_key" IS NULL)

messaging_reference_target_check.name: messaging_reference_target_check
messaging_reference_target_check.value:
("message_messaging_references"."kind" = 'channel' AND "message_messaging_references"."target_id" = "message_messaging_references"."target_conversation_id" AND "message_messaging_references"."target_thread_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("message_messaging_references"."kind" = 'thread' AND "message_messaging_references"."target_thread_id" IS NOT NULL AND "message_messaging_references"."target_id" = "message_messaging_references"."target_thread_id")

agent_request_proposal_check.name: agent_request_proposal_check
agent_request_proposal_check.value: ("agent_requests"."kind" = 'proposal') = ("agent_requests"."proposed_action" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_requests"."action_hash" IS NOT NULL) AND ("agent_requests"."kind" <> 'proposal' OR "agent_requests"."mode" = 'async')

agent_request_place_check.name: agent_request_place_check
agent_request_place_check.value: "agent_requests"."conversation_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("agent_requests"."anchor_message_id" IS NULL AND "agent_requests"."thread_id" IS NULL)

agent_status_live_place_check.name: agent_status_live_place_check
agent_status_live_place_check.value: "agent_status"."live_thread_id" IS NULL OR "agent_status"."live_conversation_id" IS NOT NULL
